column1: For the gods; that is, for the priests at their temples
For charity; that is, for the Bráhmans, Jangamas, and other mendicants
For the astrologer, or Panchánga; who, if no mendicant be present, takes also the 5 Seers
For the poor Bráhman of the village, whose office is hereditary
For the Vasaradava, who is both a carpenter and blacksmith
For the Tarugara, or Aduca, a kind of beadle
For the Gauda, or chief of the village; who out of this is obliged to furnish the village sacrifices
